frequency_question: How often do riparian states successfully sign a successor treaty or formal renewal before the expiration of a major water-sharing accord?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral water-sharing treaties expiring between 1990 and 2026 that required renegotiation. Excludes multilateral river commissions that do not rely on fixed bilateral volume-sharing quotas.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and continuous operation
Colorado River Basin 1944 Treaty Minute 319 and 323 renewals (US-Mexico)
Columbia River Treaty renegotiation talks framework
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II supplemental agreements
Soviet-era Central Asian interstate water quota renewals (Nukus Declaration framework)

coverage_note: 5 named; believed roughly 8 to 10 major comparable bilateral water treaty expiration and renewal cycles globally in this timeframe.
known_gaps: Does not capture highly asymmetrical micro-states or domestic water compacts.
skeleton: Five major historical transboundary water renegotiation episodes examined for successful successor agreements or formal extensions prior to functional expiration.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 5 named comparable episodes
validity_reason: International water law norms and bilateral hydro-diplomacy frameworks change slowly over decades.
